text:
Type: wire mesh basket with wooden handle
Use: storing and carrying fruit, vegetables, magazines or small things; kitchen, dining room, living room, home office
Style: Scandinavian, industrial, retro
Materials: green powder-coated steel mesh, solid light wood handle, metal rivets
Colors: bright lime green, light natural wood
Shape: square open basket with rounded corners, fine see-through mesh sides, solid banded rim, arched wooden handle fixed on side rivets, compact and light
Feel: cheerful, practical, fresh
Goes with: white kitchens, light wood shelves, green plants, white or grey walls; Scandinavian or retro rooms

product.name: RISATORP
product.description: This basket makes it easy to access and get an overview of your fruit and vegetables, and is decorative to display.
